newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says wages data what govt hoped for.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says wages data what govt hoped for.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Thursday wages data released earlier showed results the government had hoped for.

"Today's quarterly result in relation to average weekly ordinary time earnings of 0.7 percent for the quarter, 3.5 percent for the year, is the kind of result that we have been hoping for," Costello told reporters.
"What it shows is that the growth in wages has been restrained. We now have a low inflation environment," he said.
Figures on Wednesday showed annual inflation fell to a two year of 2.1 percent in the September quarter.
The Reserve Bank said in its Bulletin last week that wages growth remained the main obstacle to lower interest rates.
